evidence.reason: The build function operates on a caller-supplied checkout and runs the compiler without first removing the gitignored `dist/` tree. The only post-build guard checks HEAD, tracked status, and the lockfile, so stale outputs from an earlier build can survive `tsc` (which does not delete outputs for removed sources) and enter the deployment/package path. This is an ordinary artifact-correctness defect, not merely a new hardening request.
